Author: joshua88wa
Name: Nearby Player List
Punchline: A clickable list of nearby targetable players.
Description: Shows a compact, clickable list of player characters you can actually target, so you can heal or raise people in The Hunt, Diadem, Eureka, Bozja and the Occult Crescent without fighting the mouse.
FeedbackMessage: Please report bugs and suggestions on the issue tracker at https://github.com/joshua88wa/FFXIV-Dalamud-NearbyPlayerList/issues so they can be tracked and replied to.
TestingChangelog: Fixes the list moving while locked: holding Shift suspended re-pinning even when the list could not be dragged.

Author: joshua88wa
Name: Plugin Menu
Punchline: A one click menu for your installed plugins.
Description: Adds a small floating button that opens a searchable, scrollable list of every installed and enabled plugin, each with its Open and Settings windows one click away. Plugins can be hidden from the list and brought back later.
FeedbackMessage: Please report bugs and suggestions on the issue tracker at https://github.com/joshua88wa/FFXIV-Dalamud-PluginMenu/issues so they can be tracked and replied to.
